text:
English:
Good morning. Our project is SafeTriage, an agentic AI prototype for patient portal message triage. The idea is not to replace clinicians. It is to help nurses and care coordinators process messages safely, retrieve relevant guidance, draft responses, and escalate risk with a clear audit trail.
中文：
大家好。我们的项目是 SafeTriage，一个用于患者门户消息分诊的 agentic AI 原型。它不是替代医生，而是帮助护士和 care coordinator 更安全地处理消息、检索指南、生成回复草稿，并在有风险时升级处理，同时留下审计记录。
[Sources]
CA6117 Course Project Brief: prototype should show user input, agent workflow, grounding, human checkpoint, safety response, audit log, and evaluation artefacts.

text:
English:
The problem is capacity. Patient portals improve access, but they also create more asynchronous clinical work. Staff need to separate routine requests from urgent symptoms. The WHO workforce shortfall and portal-message workload studies show why this is not a small clerical issue.
中文：
这个问题本质上是医疗服务能力不足。患者门户提高了可及性，但也带来了更多异步临床工作。工作人员需要在同一个 inbox 里区分普通请求和紧急症状。WHO 的医护短缺预测和 patient portal 研究都说明，这不只是行政问题。
[Sources]
WHO Health workforce: projected shortfall of 11 million health workers by 2030. https://www.who.int/health-topics/health-workforce
Holmgren AJ et al. Patient Portal Message Volume and Time Spent on the EHR, JGIM 2024. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10973312/

text:
English:
Existing solutions are useful but incomplete. A nurse can judge context, but the workload is high. A rule system is consistent, but it is brittle. A chatbot can draft text, but it may not retrieve sources, manage state, or create an audit trail. SafeTriage is designed around the workflow rather than a single chat response.
中文：
现有方案各有作用，但不完整。护士能判断上下文，但工作量大。规则系统一致，但很脆弱。聊天机器人能写回复，但不一定会检索来源、维护状态、生成审计记录。SafeTriage 的重点是完整 workflow，而不是单次聊天回答。
[Sources]
Holmgren AJ et al. Patient Portal Message Volume and Time Spent on the EHR, JGIM 2024. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10973312/

text:
English:
This is agentic because it plans and executes multiple steps. It perceives the patient message, reasons with patient context and retrieved guidance, acts by drafting and routing, and then waits for human review. The stop condition is explicit: unsafe or high-risk messages cannot proceed as routine advice.
中文：
它之所以是 agentic，是因为它会规划并执行多个步骤。它先感知患者消息，再结合患者背景和检索到的指南进行推理，然后生成草稿和路由建议，最后等待人工审核。停止条件也很明确：高风险或不安全消息不能按普通建议处理。

The design keeps tools useful but scoped
textPreview: The design keeps tools useful but scoped

text:
English:
The system is intentionally scoped. In the prototype, the data sources are simulated. In a real setting, these would become audited APIs: patient context lookup, approved guideline search, safety-rule checks, and audit logging. Least privilege matters because an agent with broad tool access could create new risks.
中文：
系统设计是有边界的。在原型中，所有数据源都是模拟的。真实部署时，这些会变成受审计的 API：患者背景查询、批准过的指南检索、安全规则检查和审计日志。最小权限非常重要，因为 agent 如果有过多工具权限，会带来新的风险。
[Sources]
HHS HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule summaries: protect PHI/ePHI with appropriate safeguards. https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/privacy/index.html
OWASP GenAI/LLM risks include prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, and overreliance. https://owasp.org/www-project-top-10-for-large-language-model-applications/

text:
English:
Safety is not an afterthought. The system is designed so that risk changes the workflow. Red flags lead to safe stop and escalation. Hallucination risk is reduced with source grounding and human review. Prompt injection is treated as untrusted input. Privacy is handled in the prototype by using only fictional data.
中文：
安全不是事后补充，而是 workflow 的边界。风险会改变流程：红旗症状触发停止和升级；幻觉风险通过来源检索和人工审核降低；prompt injection 被视为不可信输入；隐私方面，原型只使用虚构数据。
[Sources]

text:
English:
Our evaluation is deliberately scoped. We are not claiming clinical validation. Instead, we check whether the prototype follows the required workflow: retrieve sources, classify urgency, apply safety stops, show human controls, and record an audit trail. The most useful error found was the early keyword issue around “no chest pain”, which we fixed with negation handling.
中文：
我们的评估范围是有意控制的。我们不声称临床验证，而是检查原型是否符合课程要求的 workflow：检索来源、分类紧急程度、执行安全停止、提供人工控制、记录审计日志。最有价值的错误是早期 “no chest pain” 的关键词误判，我们用否定语境处理修复了。
[Sources]

text:
English:
To conclude, SafeTriage is not an AI doctor. It is a supervised operations agent. The strongest part of the design is that the agent does useful work while staying within boundaries: it retrieves, reasons, drafts, escalates, and logs, but the human remains responsible for final action.
中文：
总结一下，SafeTriage 不是 AI 医生，而是一个受监督的医疗运营 agent。它最重要的设计点是：agent 可以做有价值的工作，但始终在边界内运行。它会检索、推理、写草稿、升级和记录，但最终行动仍由人类负责。
